independence: Reviewer authored none of these three source modules; full source and upstream APIs read independently. Some old C1/vector lexical hits were reviewer-authored, and are compared only by actual type mismatch, not presented as independent semantic review of those old modules.
scientific_conclusion: On SAME Q, W_t=B_t-u*min(t,T) has actual ALL finite Brownian laws and continuous paths; future W increments are independent of ENTIRE original B past and form an original-F_t martingale.
full_source_semantic_checks: For caller finite I, insert T and derive the joint Gaussian residual-vector/B_T law by a native linear map. Covariances of every residual coordinate with terminal are proved zero; Gaussian whole-vector-versus-terminal independence follows. No independence of residual coordinates is assumed.

Literal joint density depends only on B_T, so same Q factors as residual law × tilted terminal law; recentering terminal and affine reconstruction prove the ENTIRE I-restricted W law equals old P B law, including times beyond T. T=0 separate avoids division by0.

IsPreBrownian comes from all actual finite laws. Existing process_continuous is ALL constructed paths; subtracting deterministic clipped shift gives IsBrownian under Q, with no hidden Kolmogorov premise or uncountable AE intersection.
Regression residual uses B_T only as an analytic proof device. W_t itself reads B_t and deterministic u,t,T only; original-F_t strong adaptation is directly derived.

Original B past is a measurable deterministic shift of whole W past, so native Q Brownian increment independence transports to whole original B past. Same Q integrability and conditional mean0 establish martingale in original naturalFiltration.
After T, W subtracts uT, not ut. The independent consumer proves mean(B2−4) under Q_(2,1) is −2, while W2 is centered; crossing T=3/2 removes drift1 on [1,2].
actual_public_consumer_obligations: u=2,T=1: full joint finite table {0,1,2}, Gaussian W2 variance2
cross T=3/2 on [1,2]: Gaussian increment variance1, original F1 conditional mean0, literal shift1
Q whole original past independence; martingale original Ft; T0 and u0 IsBrownian
unclipped-after-T alternative has actual nonzero mean−2
scope_and_remaining_obligations: Scalar deterministic constant finite-horizon tilt only.
No arbitrary predictable drift or vector Girsanov.
Future B_T regression is proof-only; does not grant controller future access.

theorem residual_terminal_jointGaussian (T : ℝ≥0) (I : Finset ℝ≥0) :     HasGaussianLaw (fun ω => (residualVector T I ω,fun _ : Unit => process T ω)) sourceLaw := by   classical   let J := insert T I   let ind (i : I) : J := ⟨i,by simp [J,i.property]⟩   let last : J := ⟨T,by simp [J]⟩

theorem residual_indep_terminal (T : ℝ≥0) (hT : T ≠ 0) (I : Finset ℝ≥0) :     IndepFun (residualVector T I) (process T) sourceLaw := by   have hcov (i : I) (j : Unit) : cov[regressionResidual T i,fun ω => process T ω;sourceLaw]=0 := by     have hi : MemLp (process i) 2 sourceLaw := (process_isPreBrownian.hasLaw_eval i).hasGaussianLaw.memLp_two     have ht : MemLp (process T) 2 sourceLaw := (process_isPreBrownian.hasLaw_eval T).hasGaussianLaw.memLp_two     change cov[fun ω => process i ω-regressionCoefficient T i*process T ω,process T;sourceLaw]=0

theorem tilted_residual_terminal_map (u : ℝ) (T : ℝ≥0) (hT : T ≠ 0) (I : Finset ℝ≥0) :     (tiltedLaw u T).map (fun ω => (residualVector T I ω,process T ω)) =       (sourceLaw.map (residualVector T I)).prod (gaussianReal (u*(T : ℝ)) T) := by   change (sourceLaw.withDensity (fun ω => gaussianTiltWeight u T (process T ω))).map     (fun ω => (residualVector T I ω,process T ω)) = _   rw [map_readout_density sourceLaw _ ((residualVector_measurable T I).prodMk (measurable_process T))

theorem tilted_centered_joint_map (u : ℝ) (T : ℝ≥0) (hT : T ≠ 0) (I : Finset ℝ≥0) :     (tiltedLaw u T).map (fun ω => (residualVector T I ω,process T ω-u*(T : ℝ))) =       sourceLaw.map (fun ω => (residualVector T I ω,process T ω)) := by   have hm : (fun ω => (residualVector T I ω,process T ω-u*(T : ℝ))) =       Prod.map id (fun y : ℝ => y-u*(T : ℝ)) ∘ (fun ω => (residualVector T I ω,process T ω)) := rfl   rw [hm,← Measure.map_map (by fun_prop) ((residualVector_measurable T I).prodMk (measurable_process T)),

theorem shifted_finite_map (u : ℝ) (T : ℝ≥0) (hT : T ≠ 0) (I : Finset ℝ≥0) :     (tiltedLaw u T).map (fun ω => I.restrict (shiftedProcess u T · ω)) =       sourceLaw.map (fun ω => I.restrict (process · ω)) := by   let F : (I → ℝ) × ℝ → I → ℝ := fun p i => p.1 i+regressionCoefficient T i*p.2   have hF : Measurable F := by     apply measurable_pi_lambda

theorem shiftedProcess_measurable (u : ℝ) (T t : ℝ≥0) : Measurable (shiftedProcess u T t) :=   (measurable_process t).sub measurable_const                                                                                                                                         theorem shiftedProcess_isPreBrownian (u : ℝ) (T : ℝ≥0) :

theorem shiftedProcess_isPreBrownian (u : ℝ) (T : ℝ≥0) :     IsPreBrownianReal (shiftedProcess u T) (tiltedLaw u T) := by   constructor   intro I   have hr : Measurable (fun ω => I.restrict (shiftedProcess u T · ω)) :=     measurable_pi_lambda _ (fun (i : I) => shiftedProcess_measurable u T i)

theorem shiftedProcess_isBrownian (u : ℝ) (T : ℝ≥0) :     IsBrownianReal (shiftedProcess u T) (tiltedLaw u T) := by   refine ⟨shiftedProcess_isPreBrownian u T,Eventually.of_forall (fun ω => ?_)⟩   exact (process_continuous ω).sub (continuous_const.mul (continuous_subtype_val.comp (continuous_id.min continuous_const)))

theorem shiftedProcess_before (u : ℝ) (T t : ℝ≥0) (ht : t ≤ T) (ω : ℝ≥0 → ℝ) :     shiftedProcess u T t ω=process t ω-u*(t : ℝ) := by rw [shiftedProcess,min_eq_left ht]  theorem shiftedProcess_after (u : ℝ) (T t : ℝ≥0) (ht : T ≤ t) (ω : ℝ≥0 → ℝ) :     shiftedProcess u T t ω=process t ω-u*(T : ℝ) := by rw [shiftedProcess,min_eq_right ht]

theorem shiftedProcess_after (u : ℝ) (T t : ℝ≥0) (ht : T ≤ t) (ω : ℝ≥0 → ℝ) :     shiftedProcess u T t ω=process t ω-u*(T : ℝ) := by rw [shiftedProcess,min_eq_right ht]                                                                                                                                                         theorem shifted_indep_original_past (u : ℝ) (T s : ℝ≥0) :

theorem shifted_indep_original_past (u : ℝ) (T s : ℝ≥0) :     IndepFun (fun ω r => shiftedProcess u T (s+r) ω-shiftedProcess u T s ω)       (fun ω (r : Iic s) => process r ω) (tiltedLaw u T) := by   have hm : Measurable (fun f : Iic s → ℝ => fun r => f r+u*(min (r : ℝ≥0) T : ℝ≥0)) := by     apply measurable_pi_lambda     intro r

theorem shiftedIncrement_measurable (u : ℝ) (T s t : ℝ≥0) : Measurable (shiftedIncrement u T s t) :=   (shiftedProcess_measurable u T t).sub (shiftedProcess_measurable u T s)  theorem shiftedIncrement_indep_original_past (u : ℝ) (T s t : ℝ≥0) (hst : s ≤ t) :     IndepFun (shiftedIncrement u T s t) (fun ω (r : Iic s) => process r ω) (tiltedLaw u T) := by   have h := (shifted_indep_original_past u T s).comp (measurable_pi_apply (t-s)) measurable_id

theorem shiftedIncrement_indep_original_past (u : ℝ) (T s t : ℝ≥0) (hst : s ≤ t) :     IndepFun (shiftedIncrement u T s t) (fun ω (r : Iic s) => process r ω) (tiltedLaw u T) := by   have h := (shifted_indep_original_past u T s).comp (measurable_pi_apply (t-s)) measurable_id   have hs : s+(t-s)=t := add_tsub_cancel_of_le hst   change IndepFun (fun ω => shiftedProcess u T (s+(t-s)) ω-shiftedProcess u T s ω)     (fun ω (r : Iic s) => process r ω) (tiltedLaw u T) at h

theorem shiftedProcess_stronglyAdapted (u : ℝ) (T : ℝ≥0) :     StronglyAdapted naturalFiltration (shiftedProcess u T) := by   intro t   exact (process_stronglyAdapted t).sub stronglyMeasurable_const  theorem condExp_shiftedIncrement (u : ℝ) (T s t : ℝ≥0) (hst : s ≤ t) :

theorem condExp_shiftedIncrement (u : ℝ) (T s t : ℝ≥0) (hst : s ≤ t) :     (tiltedLaw u T)[shiftedIncrement u T s t | naturalFiltration s] =ᵐ[tiltedLaw u T] fun _ => 0 := by   have hi : Indep (MeasurableSpace.comap (shiftedIncrement u T s t) inferInstance)       (naturalFiltration s) (tiltedLaw u T) := by     rw [naturalFiltration,Filtration.natural_eq_comap]     exact shiftedIncrement_indep_original_past u T s t hst

theorem shiftedProcess_martingale (u : ℝ) (T : ℝ≥0) :     Martingale (shiftedProcess u T) naturalFiltration (tiltedLaw u T) := by   refine ⟨shiftedProcess_stronglyAdapted u T,fun s t hst => ?_⟩   have hW := shiftedProcess_isPreBrownian u T   have hi : Integrable (shiftedIncrement u T s t) (tiltedLaw u T) :=     (hW.integrable_eval t).sub (hW.integrable_eval s)
